_comment: Transcribed from in-game screenshots taken 2026-08-04 (Steam capture 20260804154347 (art), 154528-154549 and 154748 (loadout)). The page leads with the in-game class name, which is the title the loadout screen shows; the model designation rides underneath. One page covers both faction variants; both models were captured, NATO on 2026-08-04 15:43-15:48 and Pax Armata at 16:59-17:00. TBD is deliberate everywhere: a slot screen names every option in its row but describes only the highlighted one, so most options are named and not yet described.
name: Main Battle Tank
_alias_note: No bare "tank" alias. The matcher's word boundary treats a hyphen as a break, so "tank" would tag every "anti-tank" line in the log to this page.

options.name: Thermal-Blocking
options.description: Discharges a cloud of thermal smoke that obscures the vehicle. Disrupts the guidance systems of incoming lock-on missiles, blocks spotting, and deals moderate damage to enemy infantry inside the smoke radius.

options.name: Projectile Intercept
options.title: Projectile Intercept System
options.description: Intercepts and destroys enemy missiles, shells, rockets, grenades, and bombs. Intercepts all projectiles during a window of activation that begins after the initial detection.

options.name: Emergency Repair
options.description: Repairs damaged vehicles. Can only be activated when the vehicle is in a low-health state.

options.name: Field Maintenance
options.description: Enables faster vehicle health recovery after taking damage. Will also gain ammo faster.

options.name: Emergency Countermeasures
options.description: Substantially improves the recharge rate of countermeasures when at low health.

options.name: Enhanced Loading
options.description: Increases primary weapon rate of fire and improves secondary weapon heat recovery. Only active when countermeasures are not on cooldown.
options.title: Enhanced Loading Systems

options.name: Optimized Handling
options.description: Improves vehicle turning rate and aiming speed.

options.name: Heavy Machine Gun
options.description: A machine gun ideal for combatting unarmored vehicles and infantry at long range.

options.name: Light Machine Gun
options.description: A machine gun ideal for combatting enemy infantry at medium-range. Less effective against lightly armored vehicles.

options.name: Grenade Launcher
options.description: An automatic grenade launcher, effective at targeting infantry and unarmored targets at close range.

options.name: Smoke Wall
options.description: Fires multiple smoke projectiles that detonate to form a smoke wall and obscure the vehicle. Blocks ability to spot targets and clears spotted markers from all infantry inside the smoke radius.
